{{Youmay|the living space|the [[Water tank|suit]] worn by [[Iskalonian]]s, or other uses of the words "[[Water (disambiguation)|water]]" and "[[Tank (disambiguation)|tank]]"|linebreak=1}}
'''Water tanks''' were used by members of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as living spaces. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], former [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] by running a gas line of [[carbon monoxide]] into her water tank.
